'''Ree-Yees''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] criminal from [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] who suffered from a recessive genetic mutation, uncommon among Gran, which caused his hands to be deformed. He was placed in charge of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desililic Tiure's]] [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dog]], [[Buboicullaar/Legends|Bubo]].

==Biography==
[[File:ReeYees.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ree-Yees in profile]]
Ree-Yees enjoyed visiting other planets via [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]], and often brought his custom [[Ree-Yees' camera|three-eye camera]] to take pictures, despite flash photography not being allowed onboard the travel company's vessels.<ref name="Boarding Party">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=STAR TOURS Boarding Party|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/StarToursBoardingParty.asp}}</ref><ref name="ST Experience">{{YouTube|video=s9NP6iSAkVo|text=Star Tours (Original) - The Complete Experience|channel=channel/UC8fE3Sd7b9Gp5sTITX16uCg|name=Anthony's Channel}}</ref>

Ree-Yees was convicted of [[Death/Legends|murder]] on Kinyen, and was in hiding on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as a member of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] court. He was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]], and was often seen associating with [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]]. Ree-Yees was assigned the task of taking care of Jabba's pet [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dog]], [[Buboicullaar/Legends|Bubo]].

The distrustful Jabba had a short-range [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] implanted in him. When Jabba said a certain phrase, the bomb would explode, killing Ree-Yees and any one next to him. This bomb could be used to kill an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], or if Ree-Yees himself was planning to kill Jabba (as he was).

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ree-Yees was the official inventory keeper for [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. When the criminals known as the [[Sand Splitters]] stole a book, a bell and a prototype [[The Candle|warhead]] in the Palace, Ree-Yees tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with recovering the stolen items and eliminate their leaders, [[Erib Kurrugh]] and [[Saul Rouse]].<ref name="SWG:JPRB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Ree-Yees|Tatooine}}</ref> In the meantime, Ree-Yees was associated with the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]], a front for illegal activities of Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization.<ref name="SWG:DI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Digital Infection|Tatooine}}</ref>

[[File:Saelt-Marae_Ree-Yees.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ree-Yees in an argument with [[Saelt-Marae/Legends|Saelt-Marae]].]]
Ree-Yees and Tessek were conspiring to plant a bomb on the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] in order to assassinate Jabba. [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]], who was in on this scheme, promised to clear Ree-Yees's criminal record, which would allow him to return to Kinyen.

Ree-Yees then had Imperial surgeons place a small panel under Bubo's flesh, which the Gran operative could use to order in components for a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] (hidden inside shipments of [[Silvergrass|goatgrass]]) which he and Tessek planned to use to destroy Jabba's sail barge. However, when the last and most vital component, the detonator, went missing, the plan seemed to be doomed. Bubo, angry at his mistreatment at the hands of Ree-Yees, had eaten it, thus ensuring Tessek's plot would fail. Tessek, however, planted another thermal detonator on the barge.

[[File:Ree-Yees.jpg|thumb|250px|Ree-Yees in Jabba's Palace.]]
Ree-Yees did not let his disappointment stop him making a few bets with his companions when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was thrown to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor's]] pit after he had enraged Jabba. Much to everyone's surprise, Skywalker killed the beast. Ree-Yees was at [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Carkoon]] onboard Jabba's sail barge when Skywalker, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were to be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was strangling Jabba, the Hutt triggered the hypnotic trigger to make Ree-Yees grab Leia and self-destruct. However, Jabba died before he could complete the sequence. Feeling very triumphant, Ree-Yees kicked [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba's]] corpse and insulted the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Unable to escape before Leia and Luke fired the barge's cannon, Ree-Yees was killed during the sail barge's explosion shortly afterwards.<ref name="Goatgrass" />

==Equipment==
Ree-Yees used a [[Ree-Yees' camera|custom]] three-eyed [[Camera/Legends|camera]] which he used to take photos when he traveled the galaxy.<ref name="Boarding Party" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ree-Yees's name is a play on the words "three eyes."<ref name="Palace">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

In the "''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo" blog entry at StarWars.com, writer Tim Veekhoven revealed that creature performer Tim Rose "remembered that Ree-Yees was originally meant to be the Admiral of the Rebel Fleet, but that [[George Lucas]] himself appointed Ackbar".<ref name="SW-''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo">{{SW|url=news/return-of-the-jedi-creature-history-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=''Return of the Jedi'' Creature History with Pablo Hidalgo|nolive=1}}</ref> Several behind-the-scenes creature shop photos show multiple manufactured heads for the Ree-Yees character, perhaps attesting to his earlier status as a more major character.<ref name="Much to Learn">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-10-things-you-might-not-know-about-mon-calamari|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 10 Things You Might Not Know About Mon Calamari}}</ref>

Ree-Yees was performed in ''Return of the Jedi'' by [[Richard Bonehill]]<ref name="Celebration V Guide">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ebay.com/itm/384946838587|text=STAR WARS Celebration V 2010 Commemorative Guide ORLANDO FL.|archivedate=20241107193404}}</ref>, [[Paul Springer]] and [[Mike Quinn]].<ref name="SWI 47">{{InsiderCite|47|In the Star Wars Universe|In the ''Star Wars'' Universe: Mike Quinn}}</ref>

In ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'', historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] mentions speaking with Ree-Yees some time after the Battle of Endor, suggesting he actually survived the destruction of Jabba's Sail Barge, contradicting most other sources.

[[File:Ree-Yees_camera_Star_Tours.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ree-Yees in the ''Star Tours'' safety video]]
In [[Star Wars: Dark Forces|''Dark Forces'']] and [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II|''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'']], any [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] enemy is referred to as Ree-Yees (as well as also possessing his oversized hands). In [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast|''Jedi Outcast'']] and [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy|''Jedi Academy'']], the Gran were appropriately named but still had oversized hands. In the games, thermal detonators were their primary weapon, though they were also adept at melee combat.

A Ree-Yees action figure was released by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] in [[1983]], and another Ree-Yees came out in [[1998]] as part of the Power of the Force 2 line.

Ree-Yees can be seen in the onboard safety video for Disney's original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride, breaking the rules by smoking and using flash photography.<ref name="ST Experience" /> Ree-Yees was also included in a ''Star Tours'' Boarding Party action figure set with the three-eyed camera seen in the video; the packaging confirms his identity.<ref name="Boarding Party" /> Since the events of ''Star Tours'' take place after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], this may present a contradiction with ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' and the former ''[[StarWars.com]]'' [[Databank (original)|Databank]], both of which confirm that Ree-Yees died in the explosion of [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba's sail barge]] (as seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]). However, it's possible the in-universe safety video could have been filmed prior to that event.
